title: tse_tick: A Python Library for Parsing and Querying Nikkei NEEDS Tick Data from the Tokyo Stock Exchange
abstract: arXiv:2608.23053v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tick-level trade-and-quote data for the Tokyo Stock Exchange is distributed through the Nikkei NEEDS service as thousands of zipped CSV archives spanning four data types with era-dependent schemas and Japanese-language layouts. We present tse_tick, an open-source Python library that converts these raw archives into clean, typed Polars DataFrames and a Hive-partitioned Parquet store queryable through DuckDB. The library offers two access paths sharing one parse-and-clean core: a one-shot reader that returns a ticker- and time-filtered DataFrame directly from raw ZIP files, and a two-stage ingest-then-query pipeline with resume-safe, memory-aware parallel ingestion, part-pruning, and a materialized intraday time key for row-group pruning. The engineering, more than the parsing, is what the library contributes: ingestion runs in per-date atomic units whose completion is recorded by coverage markers rather than inferred from file existence,

translated_title: tse_tick：一个用于解析和查询东京证券交易所Nikkei NEEDS逐笔交易数据的Python库
translated_abstract: 东京证券交易所的逐笔交易与报价数据通过Nikkei NEEDS服务以数千个压缩的CSV归档文件形式分发，涵盖四种数据类型，具有随时代变化的模式结构和日文布局。我们提出了tse_tick，一个开源Python库，可将这些原始归档文件转换为干净、类型化的Polars数据帧，以及可通过DuckDB查询的Hive分区Parquet存储。该库提供两条访问路径，共享同一个解析和清洗核心：一个一次性读取器，可直接从原始ZIP文件返回按股票代码和时间过滤的数据帧；以及一个两阶段摄取后查询的流水线，具有可恢复、内存感知的并行摄取、分区修剪和物化的日内时间键用于行组修剪。该库的贡献主要在于工程实现，而非解析本身：摄取以每日原子单元运行，其完成状态通过覆盖标记记录，而非根据文件存在性推断。
tldr: 该论文介绍了tse_tick库，它通过原子单元摄取和覆盖标记机制，高效地将东京证券交易所的复杂CSV归档转换为可查询的Parquet存储，并支持并行处理和分区修剪。
en_tdlr: This paper presents tse_tick, a library that efficiently converts complex Tokyo Stock Exchange CSV archives into queryable Parquet storage using atomic-unit ingestion with coverage markers, enabling parallel processing and partition pruning.
